description: Angular component class for configuring customer attribute enrichment rules in the Thingsboard platform, including form setup, configuration processing, and translation selection.

classes.name: CustomerAttributesConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending RuleNodeConfigurationComponent for customer attributes configuration in rule nodes.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for the component.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and trims the output configuration object.

methods.name: prepareInputConfig
methods.description: Prepares the input configuration object based on existing configuration.

methods.name: selectTranslation
methods.description: Selects the appropriate translation string based on dataToFetch value.

methods.name: onConfigurationSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with the provided configuration.
